description: Set the postal address printed under campaign emails. Send senderPostalAddress as one line, or an empty string to clear it. US law (CAN-SPAM) asks for a postal address in commercial email. This changes no other workspace setting and sends no email. It needs setup permission, or manage for a signed-in admin or owner. A setup key works across the whole workspace and loses setup permission if its maker stops being the owner.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: set_postal_address
title: Set the postal address
